in_hebrew.name: זינס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: זינס הוא שם שמקורו ביוונית ומשמעותו 'מתנה של זנאי' או 'שמחה'. השם זינס מוזכר בברית החדשה, בספר טיטוס (טיטוס 3:13), שם מוזכר 'זינס התורגמן'. השם משויך לתקופה של השליח פאולוס והוא מעיד על השפעת התרבות היוונית-רומית על הנצרות הקדומה. השם זינס משדר שמחה ומתנה אלוהית, ומהווה חלק מהמסורת הנוצרית.

in_greek.name: Ζηνᾶς
in_greek.long_meaning: Ζηνᾶς (Zenas) προέρχεται ἀπό τὸ ἑλληνικό ὄνομα Ζηνόδωρος ἤ Ζηνᾶς, ποὺ σημαίνει 'δωρεὰ τοῦ Ζηνός' ἤ 'χαρά'. Ὁ Ζηνᾶς ἀναφέρεται στὴν Καινή Διαθήκη, συγκεκριμένα στὸ βιβλίο τοῦ Τίτου (Τίτος 3:13), ὅπου ὁ Ζηνᾶς ὀνομάζεται 'ἡμερῶν τῶν ἀδελφῶν'. Ἡ ὀνομασία Ζηνᾶς συνδέεται μὲ τὴν ἐποχὴ τοῦ ἀποστόλου Παύλου καὶ καταδεικνύει τὴν ἐπιρρόη τῆς ἑλληνορωμαϊκῆς κουλτούρας στὴν παλαιοχριστιανικὴ ἐκκλησία. Ὁ Ζηνᾶς ἀπεικονίζει χαρά καὶ θεϊκὴ δωρεὰ καὶ ἀποτελεῖ μέρος τῆς χριστιανικῆς παράδοσης.

in_latin.name: Zenas
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Zenas origine Graeco, significat 'donum Zenonis' vel 'gaudium'. In Novo Testamento, Zenas memoratur in libro ad Titum (Titus 3:13), ubi Zenas 'interpres' appellatur. Hoc nomen coniungitur cum tempore apostoli Pauli et influxum culturae Graeco-Romanae in Ecclesia primitiva Christiana demonstrat. Zenas gaudium et donum divinum repraesentat et pars traditionis Christianae est.

in_english.name: Zenas
in_english.meaning: Gift of Zeus or Zenas, joyful or happy
in_english.long_meaning: The name Zenas is of Greek origin, derived from Zenon or Zeus, meaning 'gift of Zeus' or 'joyful'. Zenas is mentioned in the New Testament, specifically in the book of Titus (Titus 3:13), where Zenas is referred to as 'the scribe'. The name is associated with the era of Apostle Paul and reflects the influence of Greco-Roman culture on early Christianity. Zenas symbolizes joy, divine gift, and has been part of Christian tradition, signifying a personality that is cheerful and blessed.

biblical_reference.note: Zenas is mentioned as a scribe or interpreter.

data.cultural_impact: Zenas is a name of Greek origin, directly translating to 'honor of Zeus'. In ancient Greek culture, Zeus was the supreme god and the king of all deities. He was believed to be the ruler of the sky and the regulator of the universe. Naming a child Zenas signified bestowing honor, power, and dominion upon the child in the eyes of Zeus.
data.spiritual_significance: In the context of the New Testament, Zenas is mentioned as a teacher of the gospel. This biblical reference signifies the profound spiritual significance associated with the name Zenas. The name embodies the principles and teachings of Christianity, with its roots in the name of the Greek god Zeus.

historical_references.reference: Zenas of Cyprus, a bishop mentioned in Acts 13:13 and 26:15, was an early Christian leader and a teacher of the gospel. He traveled with Paul and Barnabas on their first missionary journey, preaching the word of God in various Synagogues in Cyprus.
Zenas of Eleutheropolis, a Christian bishop and martyr mentioned in the 4th century Acta Sanctorum, he suffered persecution during the reign of Emperor Maxentius and was beheaded for his faith.

Some popular platforms where individuals with this name can be found include LinkedIn, where they can showcase their professional experiences and skills, Facebook, where they can connect and engage with friends and communities, and Twitter, where they can share and discuss ideas and information.
